# FG-AUTH-0028

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`oidc-login`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-login.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `invalid_org_claims_keep_the_snapshot_and_are_logged_once` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 所属の情報を読み取れなかったため、前回の所属を表示しています。
- en: Your organisation details could not be read; the previous ones are shown.
- id: Detail organisasi Anda tidak dapat dibaca; detail sebelumnya ditampilkan.

## 原因 (cause)

With `auth.oidc.claims_source = access_token` (the PFS Keycloak), the organisation claims of a verified access token (`org_units`, `positions`, `position_rank`, `plants`, `plant_code`; ADR-0021 amendment 2026-11-20) break the PFS registry's rules that GitStation mirrors: an `org_units` entry must be a JSON object, or a string holding one, with `code` matching `^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{0,19}$` and an optional boolean `primary`; a position `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`; `position_rank` an integer 0..=999 (a number or a decimal string); a plant `^[A-Z0-9]{1,4}$`; at most 64 entries per list and at most one primary department. The sign-in or the refresh check goes on (the claims are display only): the last valid values in forge.user_org_profiles stay and its `invalid_since` is set. Logged once, when `invalid_since` is set; never shown to the user. Missing claims are not an error (an empty snapshot).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.org_claims_invalid` (warn) carries `user_id`, `field` (org_units, positions, position_rank, plants, plant_code) and `reason`: format (a value breaks its pattern or the rank is out of range), too_many (more than 64 entries), multiple_primary (two primary departments), type (a claim of the wrong JSON type, e.g. an object where a list is expected, or an `org_units` string that is not JSON). The values are never logged. On the database (read-only): `SELECT user_id, invalid_since, confirmed_at FROM forge.user_org_profiles WHERE invalid_since IS NOT NULL`; `forge doctor` row `auth.oidc.org_claims` counts them.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook oidc-login, section 「PFS の組織の claim」: the attribute is set wrongly for that person in PFS (the org master, the user's positions or plants) or the `iotpf-identity` mappers changed shape. Correct it in PFS; the next sign-in or refresh check (within 5 minutes) clears `invalid_since`. Nothing to change in GitStation.
